headline: Australian Banks Lift Interest Rates Following RBA Cash Rate Hike
summary: Australian banks announced they will raise their interest rates following the Reserve Bank of Australia's decision to lift the cash rate for the fifth time in 2026.
why: Commercial banks adjust their lending and borrowing rates in tandem with central bank monetary policy adjustments to manage credit costs and margins.

impacts.name: Australia Cash Rate
impacts.why: Commercial banks raised rates following central bank action.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Commercial lending rates were increased directly in response to the Reserve Bank of Australia's policy rate hike.
